title: EU Condemns West Bank Settler Attacks on Palestinians and European Diplomats
excerpt: The European Union has strongly condemned attacks by Israeli settlers in the West Bank targeting Palestinian civilians and European diplomats.
author: LokkeeVerse Editorial
content:
The European Union has issued a strong condemnation regarding attacks by Israeli settlers against Palestinian civilians and European diplomats in the West Bank.

Belgian Foreign Minister Maxime Prevot reported that Israeli settlers had targeted both Palestinian civilians and European diplomatic representatives during the incidents.
